tested_hypothesis: XXF-1 Connector Box 10 kHz second-order Bessel LPF was ON; test whether residual phenomenological c2 is materially required after c4 is fixed to zero.

manual_reference.location: Connector Box / Anti-alias filter, manual pp. 45-48
manual_reference.documented_filter: three output-channel filters, second-order Bessel type, cutoff 10 kHz +/-2.5%
manual_reference.state_control: Connector Box top switch or DB-15 pin 12 LPF; LED indicates actual on/off state
manual_reference.measurement_time_state: unknown; this diagnostic tests the LPF-ON hypothesis only

profile_definition.nested_rule: Compare c2=0 and c2-free fits with identical Bessel normalization, cutoff freedom, detector nuisance freedom, and white-floor profiling.

interpretation.guardrail: The XXF-1 manual documents the 10 kHz +/-2.5% second-order Bessel output LPF, but the filter state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition is still unknown. This diagnostic tests whether phenomenological c2 is needed conditional on the LPF-ON hypothesis. c4 is fixed to zero in every Magnicon branch. No production data or production noise model are modified.
